title: Chicken Velouté Stew
description: A classic French stew made with tender chicken, velvety sauce, and a medley of vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add diced Canadian bacon and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove bacon from pot and set aside.
Add chicken to pot and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove chicken from pot and set aside with bacon.
Add chopped onion, minced garlic, and sprigs of thyme to pot.
Cook until onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add stew potatoes, carrots, and browned chicken back to pot.
Pour in velvety sauce and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover pot, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
